No actionable comments were generated in the recent review. ### Walkthrough For `HOURS` schedules, `buildCronExpression` now rejects `runEvery` values that are not integers of at least 1. It generates a comma-separated list of hours, stopping at `endHours - 1` when `startMinutes` exceeds `endMinutes`. Suggested reviewers: `vinaypokharkar`, `amhsirak`
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to 4dd75

Hourly schedules now generate cron hours that stay within the configured window, so a 09:30 to 10:15 schedule runs only at 09:30. The stricter `runEvery` validation accepts every value the dashboard and the documented API produce. No concrete merge-blocking risk was found.
